::: {#exm-floor}
#### Some floors

By @def-floor,

- $\floor{3.7} = 3$, since 3 is an integer at most 3.7 and 4 is not;
- $\floor{5} = 5$, since 5 is already an integer;
- $\floor{-1.5} = -2$, since $-2$ is at most $-1.5$ and $-1$ is not.

For a natural number (@def-natural-numbers) $n$,
the floor $\floor{n / 10}$ is $n$ with its last decimal digit removed,
such as $\floor{2026 / 10} = \floor{202.6} = 202$.

:::
